product.owns: user or system outcome, scope, non-goals, and acceptance behavior

investigator.owns: reproduced symptom and evidence-supported causal account

architect.owns: technical design, system boundaries, impact map, and implementation plan

security.owns: trust, authorization, privacy, abuse, and security constraints

data.owns: persistent-data invariants, schema transition, migration, and data recovery

experience.owns: user journey, interaction states, and accessibility acceptance

reliability.owns: runtime failure, performance, concurrency, observability, and operational recovery

builder.owns: application and test changes implementing the accepted plan

verifier.owns: integrated evidence and the final delivery verdict

access.question: Does this change who can read, do, or reach anything? (authentication, authorization, tenancy, secrets, payments)

stored-shape.question: Does this change the shape of persisted data, or move or delete existing data?

rendered.question: Does this change a rendered surface or a user journey?

runtime.question: Does this change external calls, concurrency, retries, or a performance budget?

irreversible.question: Is any part of this destructive, production-affecting, spending money, or a public contract change?

android.owns: Android/Kotlin platform behavior: lifecycle, background-execution limits, permissions, build/release configuration

ui-finish.owns: Visual craft and design-system depth: layout composition, spacing/typography scale, component consistency, and interaction-state visual polish

accessibility.owns: WCAG conformance depth: keyboard operability, name/role/state exposure, reflow and zoom, user-preference modes, and the AA thresholds themselves
